errors.title: Syntax Error
errors.description: SQL couldn't understand your query because of a typo or missing keyword. Check your spelling, commas, and parentheses.

errors.title: No Such Table
errors.description: You are trying to query a table that does not exist in the database. Double-check the table name in the schema browser.

errors.title: No Such Column
errors.description: The column you are selecting or filtering by doesn't exist in the referenced table.

errors.title: Missing GROUP BY
errors.description: When using an aggregate function (like COUNT, SUM, AVG) alongside normal columns, you must group the results by those normal columns.
errors.good_example: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department;

errors.title: Ambiguous Column Name
errors.description: When joining tables that have columns with the same name (like 'id'), you must specify which table's column you mean.
errors.bad_example: SELECT id FROM employees JOIN departments ON employees.dept_id = departments.id;
errors.good_example: SELECT employees.id FROM employees JOIN departments ON employees.dept_id = departments.id;
